commentary.text: 90+1' Juan Martinez Munuera is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+1' Joselu (Real Madrid) fails to convert the penalty kick! His effort hits the left post.
90+1' Joselu (Real Madrid) is going to take the penalty!
90' Poor challenge! Yan Couto (Girona) is penalised for tripping and Juan Martinez Munuera blows his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. PENALTY to Real Madrid!
88' Joselu (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a nice cross, but places his close-range header well wide of the left post.
87' Yan Couto (Girona) unleashes a cannonball of a shot from the edge of the area, but it zips narrowly wide of the left post.
86' Savio (Girona) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
83' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) bursts into the box and only has the keeper to beat, but sends a poor shot well past the right post.
83' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
81' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) and Aurelien Tchouameni matched up again to find some space for an unmarked teammate.
79' A brilliant through ball from Savio (Girona) as he picks out Yan Couto, who darted into free space to take the pass.
77' The attendance for today's match is 76585.
77' Carlo Ancelotti prepares a substitution. Ferland Mendy is replaced by Fran Garcia (Real Madrid).
77' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Arda Guler (Real Madrid) will replace Vinicius Junior.
76' Yellow card. Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
76' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
74' A crossfield pass from Pablo Torre (Girona) fails to find any of his teammates.
70' Here's the change. Ivan Martin leaves the pitch and Jhon Elmer Solis Romero (Girona) comes on as a substitute.
70' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) replaces Toni Kroos.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Joselu (Real Madrid) comes onto the pitch so that Rodrygo can be given a rest.
70' Viktor Tsygankov comes off the pitch to be replaced by Valery (Girona).
70' Artem Dovbyk goes off the pitch and Cristhian Stuani (Girona) comes on.
68' Yan Couto (Girona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
66' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Real Madrid.
63' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Viktor Tsygankov (Girona), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

61' 4 - 0 Goal! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box inside the right post. Paulo Gazzaniga had no chance of reaching it. The score is 4:0.
60' Great ball in from Aurelien Tchouameni. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) should really have done better with a close-range header, but he heads it a whisker over the crossbar.
57' Substitution. Jude Bellingham walks off the pitch and Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) comes on as a substitute.
54' 3 - 0 Goal! Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 3:0.
53' High and wide! Aleix Garcia (Girona) hits a first-time shot from distance that's none too pretty and goes miles wide of the left post.
53' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
51' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
50' Aleix Garcia (Girona) whips in a cross from the corner, but Andriy Lunin is well positioned and punches the ball away.
49' Real Madrid will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
47' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Andriy Lunin intercepts the ball.
46' Funez Salva makes a half-time substitution. Pablo Torre comes on in place of Portu (Girona).
46' The second half gets underway.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.

45+2' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) holds his head in his hands after wasting a promising chance. He latches onto a rebound, creates some space for himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box into the stands.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Yan Couto (Girona) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Andriy Lunin, who smothers the ball.
44' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
41' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
39' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:0.
35' 2 - 0 Vinicius Junior passes to Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid), who gets one-on-one with the keeper. His dummy grounds the keeper and he has a simple task lifting the ball over him into the net.
35' Girona are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
34' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez Munuera interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
33' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
31' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
31' Juan Martinez Munuera interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Savio (Girona).
29' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
28' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
26' A cross by Ferland Mendy (Real Madrid) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
25' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid).
23' The shot by Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Paulo Gazzaniga.
22' Real Madrid will look to take advantage of a free kick in a promising position in the middle of the field.
21' PENALTY APPEAL by Real Madrid, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
21' What was Juanpe (Girona) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
20' Miguel Gutierrez (Girona) sends a killer pass through the opponent's defence in an effort to find a space for Portu, who is lurking close to the offside line.
18' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Juan Martinez Munuera who sees an offensive foul.
17' The Real Madrid players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
14' Toni Kroos (Real Madrid) plays an extraordinary diagonal pass and Rodrygo darts into free space to control the ball.
12' Yan Couto (Girona) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
12' The game is interrupted now, Yan Couto (Girona) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
11' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
10' Viktor Tsygankov (Girona) sends an accurate short pass. Yan Couto controls the ball with a fine first touch and is able to come up with a new attacking effort.
7' Artem Dovbyk (Girona) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.

6' 1 - 0 What a hit that is! Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) displays his shooting ability as he slams the ball goalwards from distance. His brilliant effort bounces in off the right post, leaving the goalkeeper beaten.
5' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
4' Aleix Garcia (Girona) shows his brilliant passing ability after picking out Yan Couto with a fine lofted pass.
3' Yan Couto (Girona) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
2' Savio (Girona) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
1' The first half has just begun.
Girona will kick-off.
Juan Martinez Munuera got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
